svg.title: Swanson: connecting two literatures
svg.desc: Fish oil connects through blood viscosity and platelet aggregability to Raynaud’s syndrome. Hypothesis 1986; trial 1989.
svg.text: One set of reports linked dietary fish oil to changes in the blood. Another linked the same changes to Raynaud's syndrome. No article joined the two.
A–C: dietary fish oil might benefit patients
“these two literatures had no articles in common”
3 calendar years from explicit hypothesis to the first reported trial
The antecedent literatures are not dated here, and the paper stacks are not article counts. RA05–RA06 support the reconstruction; RA02 is only a bibliographic record. The trial
reported benefit for primary, not secondary, Raynaud’s, and did not test the two intermediate links.
Sources: RA01; RA02; RA03; RA04; RA05; RA06; RB-016
